image_order: scan_split order (same as XTX3 trainer; first N when --max-images)
net_scale: min(1, S / max(w, h)) of the whole-frame letterbox

metric_notes.sweep: detection P/R/F1 + FP split per conf threshold from one greedy matching (OKS>=0.5)
metric_notes.f1_max: sweep threshold with max F1 (ties -> lower threshold)
metric_notes.fp_match: sweep threshold whose FP/img is closest to ref_fp_per_image (ties -> higher threshold)
metric_notes.visibility_calibrated: (present, visible) thresholds 0.1..0.9 maximising visibility macro-F1 on pairs matched at conf=f1_max threshold; null without probabilities
metric_notes.AP9_coco20: same with maxDet 20 (pycocotools default for keypoints)
metric_notes.gt_without_labeled_points: ignored (COCO num_keypoints==0 rule), counted in num_ignored_gt
metric_notes.duplicates: FP with OKS>=0.5 to a GT already matched by a higher-scored detection
